news.title: SpaceX巨额IPO后，美国人财务未来将与AI紧密相连
news.snippet: 探讨SpaceX上市对美国经济及人工智能产业发展的深远影响与关联
news.raw_snippet: * [Share your views on SpaceX’s stock market debut](https://www.theguardian.com/science/2026/jun/12/spacex-stock-market-debut). First up is this week’s massive $75bn initial public offering (IPO) for Elon Musk’s SpaceX, the largest ever, which at $135 a share will value the company at a cool $1.77tn, [among the 10 largest](https://www.alpha-sense.com/largest-companies-by-market-cap/) companies in the world by market capitalization. Even investors who don’t care to buy their stock will end up owning a bunch, either in their 401(k) retirement plans or among their holdings of market index funds – supposedly safer investments for non-professional investors, built to reflect the entire market – which are forced to buy AI shares in proportion to their weighting in stock indices like the Nasdaq and the S&P. Adding SpaceX, OpenAI and Anthropic to this set will give tech billionaires an even tighter grip on Americans’ financial future as they pursue their [dystopian sci-fi dreams](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/ng-interactive/2026/may/31/transhuman-silicon-valley-ai), free from any sort of [government regulation](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/jun/08/trump-ai-growth-anthropic). news.raw_snippet: And no matter where the share price heads in the coming weeks, months, and years, one thing is for certain: SpaceX will be deploying its new capital at breakneck speed. In the company's 370-page IPO prospectus, the word "competition" appears more than 180 times. But there's also quite a bit of commentary regarding how stiff competition for SpaceX's core markets is expected to be. "[O]ur AI business is subject to challenges inherent in a nascent, highly competitive, capital intensive and rapidly changing industry," the IPO prospectus warns. Even the company admits to this. ## This AI stock will surely benefit from the SpaceX IPO. Colossus 1 -- a SpaceX facility that the company believes is "one of the world's largest and fastest-deployed AI supercomputers" -- has more than 220,000 Nvidia GPUs at its core. But for the next several years, the company will likely have little choice but to buy massive amounts of Nvidia GPUs. To buy SpaceX stock during or after the IPO, you must be very bullish on AI.

news.title: OpenAI IPO：投资者认购前必看指南
news.snippet: 投资这家顶尖AI初创公司IPO前必须审视的核心要素、技术壁垒与估值指标
news.raw_snippet: # OpenAI IPO: What Investors Must See From the Top AI Startup Before Buying Its Stock. * OpenAI has confidentially filed IPO paperwork with the SEC, though the company has not yet provided a timeline for when it plans to go public. OpenAI joins key rivals Anthropic and SpaceX (SPCX) in filing for an initial public offering (“IPO”). As part of its IPO announcement, OpenAI did not reveal key details such as the amount of money it was looking to raise, a potential valuation for the company, or even a time frame for the IPO. But with the SpaceX IPO on June 12 and Anthropic’s IPO likely coming sooner rather than later, OpenAI may have felt pressure to at least formally announce its intentions, even though it had been a rumored IPO candidate for months. While details of OpenAI’s exact IPO valuation remain unclear, investors should expect the figure to exceed its most recent valuation of $852 billion.
